t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice is basically tryoing to tell me to use up or stick to a particular gnome or basket and max it out before switching to a new gnome or basket color

vb_textbox.text: There are 4 gnomes that brings up red or yellow baskets, the red basket comes when you select red, brown, pink or purple gnomes respectively. Everyother gnomes other than the gnomes mentioned above will bring up the yellow gnomes. For best result i.e in other to get the most mushrooms, just select different gnomes that are not related to thesame gnomes at intervals. i.e to say when you pick a gnome for red basket, pick another category that brings up yellow basket.
